full-name: Bessie Annie Pond
first-name: Bessie Annie
last-name: Pond
title: Bessie Annie Pond
dates: (b.1871)
---

CMY\'s maid in 1901, see Coleridge, Life 346.

She had a younger sister named Edith Pond, who was housemaid to Maurice Yonge at the time of the 1901 census (just after CMY\'s death).

They were the daughters of Francis Pond, cabinet-maker, of Wantage.
